payload.name: operation
payload.description: A compact symbolic operation for the current turn, including any reference resolution plus filter/select/count/aggregate/compare/list operation.

payload.name: answer
payload.description: Return the final answer for the current turn as a JSON array of strings. For one answer, return a one-element array. Preserve each complete table-cell value as one string.

payload.content: Write a compact symbolic table operation in `operation`, including prior-turn reference resolution if needed. Then put only the final answer list in `answer`.
Return only the fields shown in the output format instructions. Keep intermediate reasoning in the reasoning/workpad field(s), and keep the final result in the final output field.

rationale: Visible operation-answer scaffold for testing whether explicit symbolic table-operation representation improves SQA behavior.
